blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Multimodal language models traditionally rely on dedicated perceptual encoders to construct task-usable representations. More integrated architectures have recently emerged, which instead expose the shared transformer to lightly projected patches, audio frames, or discrete visual tokens. Where does this encoding happen when such representations are not provided? We find that the transformer can internalize this missing computation, constructing task-usable perceptual representations within its own early-to-middle layers before the downstream language model. We call this computational structure a Virtual Encoder . Across linear probing, similarities to perceptual encoders, and causal analyses, we identify signatures of this structure in models that receive perceptual tokens without continuous encoder-derived features.
These analyses also suggest that the boundary between perception and language processing need not coincide within an architectural module. Instead, encoder-like computation can emerge as a functional regime within a shared transformer, providing a new perspective for understanding where and how multimodal models process perception.

多式联运模式传统上依赖专用的感知编码器来构建可用于任务的表示. 最近出现了更集成的架构,反而让共享变压器暴露在轻度投射的补丁,音频帧,或离散的视觉符号上. 不提供这种说明时,这种编码在哪里进行? 我们发现变压器可以将这种缺失的计算内部化,在下游语言模型之前,在自己的早期到中层内构建可任务使用的感知表示. 我们称这个计算结构为虚拟编码器。 通过线性测试,与知觉编码器的相似性,以及因果分析,我们发现这种结构的签名在模型中接收到知觉符号,而无需连续的编码器衍生特征.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
The development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has been progressively bringing
perception and language processing closer together. We organize current designs into three architectural families (Figure 2 ). Encoder-full MLLMs use a dedicated vision or audio encoder to construct continuous perceptual features before passing them to a language model through cross-attention, a resampler, or a projector [ 2 , 21 , 24 , 12 , 4 ] . Discrete-token MLLMs represent perceptual inputs as discrete codes in the same autoregressive stream as text, as in Chameleon and Emu3 [ 8 , 37 ] . Encoder-free MLLMs omit a dedicated perceptual encoder and feed lightly projected image patches or audio frames into the shared Transformer, as in Fuyu, EVE, SOLO, and Gemma 4 [ 6 , 14 , 9 , 17 ] . Unlike encoder-full MLLMs, these two families thus shift multimodal perception from a dedicated external encoder into a part of the transformer-based language model itself.
blocks.zh:
多式联运大型语言模型的发展正在逐步带来
感知和语言处理更紧密地结合在一起. 我们把目前的设计组织成三个建筑家庭(图2)。 Encoder-full MLLMs使用一个专用的视觉或音频编码器来构建连续的感知特性,然后通过交叉意念,重塑器,或投影器[2,21,24,12,4]传递给语言模型. discrete-token MLLMs在文本与Chameleon 和 Emu3 中一样,代表作为离散码的感知输入。 无编码器的MLLM省略了专用的知觉编码器,并将轻度投射的图像补丁或音频帧输入共享的变形器,如Fuyu,EVE,SOLO,和Gemma 4 [6,14,9,17]. 与编码器全MLLM不同,这两个家族因此将多式联运感知从专用的外部编码器转变为变压器语言模型本身的一部分.

blocks.en: This raises an intriguing question: How do perception and language processing coexist in a single Transformer-based model? Perceptual encoding and language processing may require qualitatively different computations. Moreover, although encoder-free and discrete-token MLLMs allow perceptual and language tokens to interact from the earliest layers, meaningful cross-modal interaction may require higher-level representations to be established first. That is, architectural unification does not necessarily imply computational unification. Perceptual encoding may be organized as a distinct functional stage within the shared Transformer. Although architectural boundaries disappear, deeper analysis of such a model may identify the functional boundaries that replace perceptual encoders.
blocks.zh: 这提出了一个令人感兴趣的问题: 认知和语言处理如何在单一的变形器模型中共存? 概念编码和语言处理可能需要质的不同的计算. 此外,虽然无编码器和离散的MLLMs允许知觉符号和语言符号从最早的层次相互作用,但有意义的跨模式交互可能要求首先建立更高层次的表示. 也就是说,建筑统一并不一定意味着计算统一。 概念编码可以组织为共享变形器内一个独特的功能阶段. 虽然建筑边界消失了,但更深入地分析这种模型可能会发现取代知觉编码器的功能边界.

blocks.en: We hypothesize that discrete-token and encoder-free MLLMs internalize part of the perceptual encoding normally performed by a dedicated encoder. Specifically, an early band of Transformer layers organizes perceptual tokens into a task-usable representation and thereby assumes an encoder-like computational role. We call this functional regime a Virtual Encoder (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们假设这个离散的键和无编码器的 MLLMs 将部分通常由专用编码器完成的感知编码内化. 具体来说,一个早期的变形器层组将知觉符组织成一个任务可操作的表示,从而承担一个像编码器的计算角色. 我们称这个功能系统为虚拟编码器(图1).

blocks.en: Based on this hypothesis, we study encoder-free and discrete-token MLLMs and compare them with encoder-full MLLMs through linear probing [ 1 ] , representational similarity [ 20 ] , and causal analyses with perturbations over image and audio inputs. We set Gemma 4 12B [ 17 ] as our primary target model and consistently identify an encoder-like structure in it, forming the perceptual representation in early-to-middle layers, which are then read out.
blocks.zh: 基于这一假设,我们研究无编码器和离散托接的MLLM,并通过线性测试[1],代表相似性[20],以及对图像和音频输入的扰动的因果分析,将其与编码器全MLLM进行比较. 我们把Gemma 4 12B [17] 设定为我们的首要目标模型,并一致确定其中的编码器类似结构,形成早期到中层的知觉代表,然后读出来.

blocks.en: Contributions . We introduce the Virtual Encoder, a functional regime in which a shared Transformer internally constructs perceptual representations when no continuous encoder-derived features are supplied. We show four properties. (1) Encoder-free and discrete-token MLLMs develop semantic decodability progressively over depth, whereas encoder-full MLLMs start with already organized representations. (2) Their early hidden states exhibit encoder-like geometry, and in Gemma 4 12B these states are directly sensitive to low-level perceptual structure. (3) The resulting representations are causally read out at architecture-specific depths. (4) Their subsequent routing is modality- and architecture-dependent, with vision in Gemma 4 12B transiently aligning with the language subspace near readout while audio follows a markedly different trajectory.
blocks.zh: 捐款. 我们引入了虚拟编码器,这是一种功能性制度,在一个共享的变形器内部,在没有提供持续的编码器衍生特性时,构建了知觉表达. 我们显示四个属性。 (1) 无编码器和离散托起的MLLMs在深度上逐步发展语义解码性,而编码器完整的MLLMs则从已经组织的表示开始. (2)它们的早期隐藏状态表现出编码器般的几何,在Gemma 4 12B中,这些状态对低水平的知觉结构直接敏感. (3) 由此产生的表述在结构特定深度处因果宣读。 (4)它们随后的路由是模式和架构依赖的,在Gemma 4 12B中视线瞬间与接近读出的语言子空间对齐,而音频则遵循明显不同的轨迹.

blocks.en: 2.1 Multimodal Large Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 多式联运大语文模式

blocks.en:
Early MLLMs extended large language models with dedicated perceptual
encoders and lightweight bridging modules. CLIP [ 32 ] and
SigLIP [ 39 ] provided pretrained visual representations, while
models such as Flamingo [ 2 ] ,
BLIP-2 [ 21 ] , LLaVA [ 24 ] , and
InstructBLIP [ 12 ] connected such features to language
models through cross-attention, Q-Former-style modules, or learned projectors.
More recent families, including Qwen-VL [ 4 , 36 , 5 ] and InternVL [ 10 ] , further improve visual-language
alignment while retaining a dedicated vision encoder. Across these
architectures, perceptual representations are therefore constructed before
entering the language model stack. Audio-language models have followed a similar trajectory, with models such as Qwen2-Audio relying on a dedicated audio encoder to produce continuous acoustic representations before language-model processing [ 11 ] . More recent unified models such as Gemma 4 instead process audio frames within the shared Transformer, further blurring the boundary between perception and language processing [ 17 ] .

blocks.en: Discrete-token MLLMs weaken the boundary between perceptual and language processing by placing discrete perceptual codes in the same autoregressive stream as text. Chameleon [ 8 ] and Emu3 [ 37 ] follow this design. Encoder-free MLLMs remove the dedicated perceptual encoder more directly. Fuyu [ 6 ] feeds linearly projected image patches into the Transformer, while EVE [ 14 , 15 ] and SOLO [ 9 ] train single-Transformer models without an external vision encoder. Mono-InternVL [ 25 ] incorporates visual experts within a monolithic language model, and Gemma 4 [ 17 ] extends encoder-free processing to image and audio inputs.
blocks.zh: discrete-token MLLMs通过将离散的知觉代码与文本放在相同的自递流中来削弱知觉处理和语言处理之间的界限. 变色龙[8]和Emu3[37]遵循这一设计. 无编码器的MLLMs更直接地去除专用的知觉编码器. Fuyu [6] 将线性投射的图像补丁输入变形器,而EVE [14,15] 和SOLO [9] 列车的单变形模型则没有外视编码器. Mono-InternVL [25] 将视觉专家融入到单一语言模型中,Gemma 4 [17] 将无编码器处理扩展到图像和音频输入.

blocks.en: Discrete-token and encoder-free MLLMs differ in their input units and parameterization, but neither supplies the shared Transformer with continuous features from a dedicated perceptual encoder. We ask how their shared Transformers form perceptual representations and when those representations become available to language processing.
blocks.zh: discrete-token和无编码器的MLLM在输入单元和参数化上有所不同,但两者都没有从专用的知觉编码器中向共享的变形器提供连续的特性. 我们问,他们共享的变换器如何形成概念性表述,以及这些表述何时可用于语言处理。

blocks.en: Prior work has primarily evaluated these architectures through downstream performance, leaving their internal perceptual computation largely unexplored. We instead ask how perceptual representations are constructed across Transformer layers when no continuous encoder-derived representation is provided.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作主要通过下游的性能来评价这些架构,使得其内部的感知计算基本没有被探索. 相反,我们询问,在没有提供连续编码器衍生的表示的情况下,如何在变形器各层构建概念表达。

blocks.en: 2.2 Representation Analysis in Multimodal Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 多式联运模式中的表述分析

blocks.en:
Our analysis relies on two complementary views of latent representations: what information they encode and how they are geometrically organized. Linear probes have been widely used to test what is linearly decodable at a given layer [ 1 ] . Representation similarity is benefical to find encoder-like structure in a model. Centered kernel alignment (CKA) [ 20 ] , singular vector canonical correlation analysis [ 33 ] , and projection-weighted canonical correlation analysis [ 27 ] compare representations within and across networks. Intrinsic-dimension analyses further characterize how representation geometry changes across network depth [ 3 , 34 ] . A complementary line of work studies representations as linear subspaces, including the linear representation hypothesis [ 30 ] .
Principal angles give a classical comparison between two subspaces [ 7 ] , while cross-projected variance measures how much activity from one condition is captured by another condition’s PCA subspace [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们的分析依赖于对潜在表述的两种补充观点:它们编码了哪些信息,它们是如何几何排列的。 线性探测器被广泛用于测试在给定层[1]中线性可解码的东西. 代表性相似性在模型中找到类似编码器的结构是负面的. 中心内核对齐(CKA)[20],单向矢量犬科关联分析[33],和预测加权犬科关联分析[27]比较网络内部和网络之间的表示. 透视-二元分析进一步描述跨网络深度的表达几何变化[3,34]. 互补的工作线研究表示为线性子空间,包括线性表示假说[30].
主角度给出了两个子空间之间的经典比较[7],而交叉预测的差价测量一个条件的活度被另一个条件的PCA子空间捕获多少[16].

blocks.en: Such tools have identified some characteristic structures in multimodal models. The modality gap [ 22 ] describes the separation of image and text representations in a shared space, while Nikankin et al. [ 29 ] identify modality-specific circuits and late cross-modal alignment within VLMs. Jain et al. [ 19 ] further show that intermediate LLM states contain visual perceptual representations whose quality correlates with downstream performance, and Venhoff et al. [ 35 ] study how representations produced by a dedicated vision encoder progressively map into the language feature space.
blocks.zh: 这些工具确定了多式联运模式中的一些特征结构。 模式差距[22]描述在共享空间中图像和文本表达的分离,而Nikankin等人. [29] 在VLM中确定特定模式的线路和晚期的交叉模式对接. Jain 等 (英语). [19] 进一步表明中间LLM状态包含视觉透视表达,其质量与下游性能相关,以及Venhoff等人. [35] 研究专用视觉编码器生成的表示法如何逐步映射到语言特征空间.

blocks.en: Our focus differs in asking how perceptual representations are first constructed when no continuous modality-encoder representation is provided, and how the resulting Virtual Encoder output is subsequently routed among modality-specific and language-aligned subspaces within the shared residual stream.
blocks.zh: 我们的侧重点不同,我们询问,在没有提供连续模式编码器表示时,如何首先构建知觉表示,以及由此产生的虚拟编码器输出随后如何在共享剩余流内特定模式和语言对齐的子空间之间进行路由。

blocks.en: 4 The Virtual Encoder
blocks.zh: 4 虚拟编码器

blocks.en: Encoder-full MLLMs delegate perception to a dedicated encoder. A Vision Transformer or audio spectrogram model transforms the raw signal into a continuous semantic representation before it reaches the shared Transformers. Encoder-free models omit this stage and take lightly projected patches or frames directly as input, while discrete-token MLLMs take discrete perceptual codes. Our central hypothesis is that, in the latter two cases, an early band of Transformer layers internalizes the missing computation and comes to play the functional role of a modality-specific encoder. We call this early-layer regime the Virtual Encoder.
blocks.zh: 编码器全 MLLMs 将感知委托给专用编码器. 一个视觉变形器或音频光谱模型在到达共享变形器之前将原始信号转换成连续语义表现. 无编码器模型省略了这个阶段,直接将轻度投射的补丁或帧作为输入,而离散的token MLLMs则取离散的知觉代码. 我们的中心假设是,在后两种情况下,一个早期的变形器层将缺失的计算内化,并来发挥一个模式特定编码器的功能作用. 我们把这个早期政权称为虚拟编码器。

blocks.en: To test this hypothesis, we ask three questions. (i) When do perceptual representations become semantically organized? (ii) Do intermediate representations exhibit geometry similar to that of a dedicated encoder? (iii) Until what depth are modality-token states causally required for the output? We investigate these questions through linear probing, representational similarity, and causal intervention. We primarily study the encoder-free Gemma 4 12B. The cross-model analyses additionally include the encoder-free EVE [ 15 ] and Fuyu [ 6 ] , the discrete-token Chameleon [ 8 ] , and the encoder-full controls LLaVA-1.5 [ 24 ] , Qwen3-VL [ 5 ] , Qwen3-Omni [ 38 ] , and Qwen2-Audio [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了测试这个假设,我们提出三个问题. (一) 概念性陈述何时开始组织起来? (二) 中间表示法是否显示几何形状与专用编码器相似? (三) 直至产出因果需要何种深度模式操作状态? 我们通过线性测试、代表性相似性和因果干预来调查这些问题。 我们主要研究无编码器的Gemma 4 12B. 跨模型分析还包括无编码器的EVE [15] 和 Fuyu [6],离散托式变色龙 [8],以及编码器全控LLaVA-1.5 [24],Qune3-VL [5],Qune3-Omni [38],和Qune2-Audio [11].

The layer-wise accuracy is shown in Fig. 3 . In the encoder-free MLLMs, semantic information becomes increasingly linearly decodable with depth. For Gemma 4 12B on images, accuracy rises from 8.4 % 8.4\% at the projection output at layer 0 to a peak of 95.5 % 95.5\% at layer 21, and EVE ( 23.5 % → 92.6 % 23.5\%\!\to\!92.6\% at layer 0 to 23) and Fuyu ( 9.7 % → 91.3 % 9.7\%\!\to\!91.3\% at layer 0 to 32) show similar trends. In contrast, the encoder-full Qwen3-VL and LLaVA-1.5 already exhibit highly decodable representations at layer 0, with Qwen3-VL reaching 94.2 % 94.2\% . Their Transformer inputs have already been organized by a dedicated modality encoder.
The discrete-token Chameleon also builds comparable decodability only after a substantial stretch of Transformer computation. Its decodability is low at layer 0, climbs to a peak at layer 8, and then declines in later layers.

blocks.en: The audio pathway of the encoder-free Gemma 4 12B exhibits an even more pronounced depth-dependent pattern. Probe accuracy climbs from 5.2 % 5.2\% at layer 0 to 87.7 % 87.7\% at layer 6, but then declines to 36.1 % 36.1\% by the final layer. In contrast, the encoder-full Qwen2-Audio is 96.8 % 96.8\% decodable at layer 0 and stays above 97 % 97\% throughout. Gemma 4 12B thus forms a strongly decodable audio representation early but does not maintain that level of decodability downstream.

blocks.zh: 4.2 类似编码器的早期图层展览

blocks.en: We test whether hidden states in discrete-token and encoder-free MLLMs share geometric structure with representations from a dedicated single-modal encoder. Encoder-full MLLMs provide controls whose Transformer inputs have already been organized by such an encoder.

blocks.en: Finding 2 Models given patches or discrete image tokens have stronger similarity between their early states and early DINOv2 states than models given continuous encoder features. In Gemma 4 12B, direct sensitivity to high-frequency removal further shows that the early layers process low-level visual structure. These similarities describe how the representations are organized.

blocks.en: 4.3 The Virtual Encoder’s Output is Causally Read Out at Model-Specific Depth
blocks.zh: 4.3 虚拟编码器的输出是在模型特定深度的空心读出

blocks.en: In an encoder-full MLLM, perceptual information reaches the shared Transformer only after the dedicated encoder has completed its computation. In discrete-token and encoder-free MLLMs, perceptual tokens enter the multimodal Transformer directly and can transfer information to other token positions from the first block. We perturb modality-token states at individual depths to determine when later computation ceases to depend on those states.
blocks.zh: 在编码器全MLLM中,知觉信息只有在专用编码器完成计算后才能到达共享变形器. 在离散的托肯和无编码器的MLLMs中,知觉符直接进入多式联运变形器,并且可以从第一个区块将信息传输到其他符号位置. 我们扰动模式键在单个深度的状态,以确定以后的计算何时不再依赖于这些状态.

blocks.en: 4.4 An Early-Layer Virtual Encoder Regime
blocks.zh: 4.4 早期Layer虚拟编码器制度

blocks.en: Taken together, the probe, representational similarity, and causal readout identify an early-to-middle regime in Gemma 4 12B that behaves as an implicit modality encoder. We refer to this computational role as the Virtual Encoder. Related probe and representational signatures appear in other models without continuous encoder features, while Chameleon exhibits a similar but earlier causal readout transition. A Virtual Encoder is a functional description whose presence and depth must be established empirically.

blocks.en: We next ask whether the different downstream behaviors of vision and audio are reflected in how their representations occupy the shared residual stream. We focus on Gemma 4 12B, where image, text, and audio tokens are processed within the same residual stream by the same set of transformer weights. This shared d d -dimensional space allows us to directly compare the modality-specific subspaces formed at each depth and to ask where the Virtual Encoder places its output relative to the language subspace. In particular, because all modalities share a common coordinate system, their subspace geometry can be quantified using principal angles, unlike the cross-model comparison in Section 4.2 , where we instead relied on the angle-invariant CKA measure.

The computational role does not require one universal routing geometry. Chameleon provides a useful counterpoint (Figure 6 d). Its image-text overlap rises from 0.059 0.059 at layer 0 to a modest early peak of 0.091 0.091 at layer 4, then decreases across the
causal readout transition to 0.047 0.047 at layer 11. It therefore does not reproduce Gemma 4 12B’s readout-aligned rotation. Thus constructing and consuming a perceptual representation inside the Transformer also occurs in a discrete-token MLLM, while the route taken through the residual stream is architecture dependent. In Gemma 4 12B, modalities occupy only weakly overlapping subspaces, with vision rotating from an image-private subspace toward the language subspace around readout.

blocks.en: Taken together, Sections 4 and 5 separate three properties of the Virtual Encoder. They show where a perceptual representation is formed, when it is causally consumed, and how it is routed. Gemma and Chameleon support the first two properties, whereas their subspace trajectories differ. A Virtual Encoder offers the computational role of internally constructing a usable perceptual representation before readout, rather than by a particular layer interval or routing geometry.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The Virtual Encoder perspective separates when perceptual representations are formed, when they are read out from modality tokens, and how they are routed afterward. Its strength and depth may depend on how much perceptual processing remains after fusion, placing architectures on a continuum rather than in a fixed encoder-free category. This view makes readout depth and modality-to-language alignment potential design variables. Controlling them may help locate information loss, improve fusion, and preserve perceptual evidence for downstream reasoning.
blocks.zh: 虚拟编码器视角区分了知觉表达方式形成时,从模式符读出时,以及其后的路由方式. 其强度和深度可能取决于聚变后的感知处理还剩多少,将架构置于一个连续体而不是固定的无编码器类别中. 这种观点使读取深度和模式对语言的对齐性成为潜在的设计变量. 控制它们可能有助于查找信息损失,改善聚变,并保存下游推理的认知证据。

blocks.en: Our evidence nevertheless leaves important gaps. The full image-text-audio subspace analysis is limited to Gemma 4 12B, while Chameleon provides only an image-text comparison. The language subspace is operationally defined by PCA of text representations. We do not intervene directly on subspace rotation, and audio’s weak language alignment is only correlated with its loss of decodability. Controlled front-end comparisons, direct routing interventions, and broader cross-architecture evaluation are therefore needed to establish when Virtual Encoders arise and whether their geometry causally affects model behavior.
blocks.zh: 然而,我们的证据留下了重要的空白。 完整的图像文本-audio子空间分析仅限于Gemma 4 12B,而Chameleon只提供了图像文本比较. 语言子空间在操作上由PAC对文本表述的定义. 我们并不直接干预子空间旋转, 音频的弱语言校正只与其失去解码性有关。 因此,为了确定虚拟编码器何时出现以及它们的几何因果影响模型行为,需要控制前端比较,直接路由干预,以及更广泛的跨结构评价.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We identify the Virtual Encoder as a regime in which an MLLM internally forms a usable perceptual representation before causal readout. Its depth and routing vary across architectures.
Together, these findings provide a concrete way to identify and study encoder-like computation inside encoder-free multimodal models, rather than assuming it from the architecture alone.

这些结论共同为在无编码器的多式联运模型内识别和研究类似编码器的计算提供了具体的方法,而不是仅仅从架构中假设.
